title.zh: 比特币闪电网络钱包Blink Wallet对闲置托管账户收费，每月扣1美元直至余额清零
title.en: 比特币闪电网络钱包Blink Wallet对闲置托管账户收费，每月扣1美元直至余额清零

current_state.zh: Blink Wallet started charging a $1-per-month inactivity fee on custodial BTC and USD balances dormant for 12 months, deducting until balances are depleted, affecting roughly 100,000 accounts holding over $800,000, with fees refunded automatically if users log back in while self-custodial accounts are unaffected.
